subject: hindi
verifiedAgainst: NCERT textbook listing (ncert.nic.in/textbook.php dropdown script) + Contents page in the book prelims PDF + opening page of every chapter PDF (/textbook/pdf/{code}{NN}.pdf)
note: Chapter titles and unit names are transcribed from the Contents page (कहाँ क्या है?) of the NCERT prelims PDF; the unit names are in a legacy font there and were read from the chapter PDFs. Readings marked * (तारांकित — for reading only) are not chapters: they are listed under extraReadings on the chapter whose PDF contains them. bookLabel is the activity label printed at the top of the lesson (सुनें कहानी / आनंदमयी कविता / मिलकर पढ़िए). Authors are given only where the chapter PDF or the acknowledgements page names one; spellings were normalised by hand because the PDF text layer garbles matras.
